optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, E-commerce Fulfilment Software

professionalSummary.text: Owner of the monthly merchant billing run for a fulfilment platform, managing billing credits up to a delegated limit of $15,000 per merchant per month and coordinating with finance leadership for larger adjustments.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the monthly merchant billing run for the fulfilment platform for nearly three years, approving billing credits under my delegated limit of 15,000 per merchant per month in the billing system and referring larger credits to the head of finance operations.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained billing rules and merchant rate cards, logging each change with contract amendment references.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the billing rules and merchant rate cards in the billing system, logging each rate-card change with the contract amendment reference.

professionalSummary.text: Led the monthly billing review with account management, deciding disputed invoices and recording outcomes.
professionalSummary.witness: Led the monthly billing review with account management, deciding which disputed invoices were held and recording the outcomes in the review record.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated billing disputes with account management and collections, defining responsibility boundaries for merchant conversations, dunning, and billing decisions.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated billing disputes with account management and collections, recording that account management owned the merchant conversation and collections owned dunning while I owned the billing decision.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions after each billing run.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included billing-run ownership, credit approvals within limit, rule and rate-card maintenance and the billing review for the fulfilment platform over about three years.

experienceHighlights.text: Three years of ownership over a monthly billing run for ~600 merchants on a per‑order pricing model.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the monthly merchant billing run for the fulfilment platform for nearly three years...

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Credit approval log and billing review record for one month, including system run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the credit approval log showing approvals under the candidate's user id and the billing review record for one month, with the billing system's run identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s ownership of the monthly billing run, approval authority, rule maintenance, review leadership, dispute coordination, and documentation practices. They do not provide independent verification of the accuracy of billing or the specific volume of merchants handled.
